name: Sample Shadow Barrage Rogue

mechanics.coreLoop: Build Combo Points with a Basic skill, spend them through Barrage, and use Shadow Imbuement to turn pack clears into chain damage.

coreInteractions.name: Combo Point Barrage cadence
coreInteractions.summary: Barrage is treated as the main spender, with Combo Points providing the repeatable damage state.

coreInteractions.name: Shadow Imbuement pack clear
coreInteractions.summary: Shadow Imbuement gives the build an area clear layer while the rest of the shell supports projectile uptime.

breakpoints.name: Stable resource cycle
breakpoints.target: Enough Energy support to cast Barrage after setup without long generator downtime.

failureModes.name: Resource starvation
failureModes.impact: Barrage uptime falls apart and the build becomes a weak Basic-skill shell.

guide.overview: A compact guide shape for the planner UI: JSON in, readable progression out, with enough structure for later validation scripts.

rotation.summary: Set up Combo Points, fire Barrage into dense targets, and refresh Shadow Imbuement for pack clears.
sequence: Build Combo Points with Puncture or another Basic skill.
Cast Shadow Imbuement before a pack or elite wave.
Use Dash or Shadow Step to keep firing lanes clean.

steps.title: Open the core loop
goals: Unlock a Basic skill and Barrage before adding utility.
Add Dash once movement starts saving more time than extra damage.
actions: Prioritize Barrage ranks over side utility.
Keep early skill choices narrow so the first respec pass stays painless.
steps.notes: This is guide structure, not final Rogue advice.

steps.title: Layer in shadow clears
goals: Slot Shadow Imbuement for packs and dungeon rooms.
Start tracking legendary effects that improve the main spender.
actions: Use Shadow Imbuement before dense pulls.
Pick up Shadow Step when control effects start slowing the run.

steps.title: Tighten survival and burst
goals: Bring defensive uptime online before pushing harder content.
Move filler points into passives once the skill bar feels locked.
actions: Prefer affixes that keep the same rotation easier to repeat.
Add defensive tools before testing higher incoming damage.

steps.title: Convert the guide into targets
goals: Turn build JSON into board, glyph, and gear sections.
Separate required pieces from nice-to-have chase items.
actions: Record the first board order and socketed glyphs when the real build exists.
Keep each upgrade step tied to a visible reason.
